name: C1-3 the same image through four different 3×3 kernels
description: Edge, sharpen, vertical edge and blur, printed as grids

data.noteContent:
Figure C1-3-e of the textbook, made runnable. One hand-built 8x8 picture goes into four Conv2dExplicit nodes at once. The arithmetic is the same in all four -- slide a 3x3 window, multiply, add -- and only the nine numbers inside the window differ, so the four Prints are four answers to the same question about the same pixels.

The picture is typed in rather than generated, so every kernel has exactly two things to report on: one vertical edge and one isolated bright pixel.

Read the grids away from the outer ring. Padding is zero, so the border sees an edge that is not in the picture.

課本圖 C1-3-e 的可執行版。一張手工排出來的 8x8 圖，同時送進四個 Conv2dExplicit。四邊的算法完全一樣 -- 滑動 3x3 視窗、相乘、相加 -- 差別只在視窗裡那九個數字，所以四個 Print 是同一批像素、同一個問題的四種答案。

這張圖是手動填的、不是亂數生的，所以每個 kernel 要回報的就只有兩樣東西：一條垂直邊，和一個孤立的亮點。

看這四張格子時請避開最外圈。padding 補的是 0，邊界因此會看到一條圖裡根本沒有的邊。

The values are typed in, not generated: columns 0-3 are 100, columns 4-7 are 200, and row 6 column 1 holds a single 200 in the dark half. Change one number and all four Prints change with it.

這些數值是手動填的，不是生出來的：第 0-3 欄是 100、第 4-7 欄是 200，第 6 列第 1 欄在暗的那半放了一個 200。改動其中一個數字，四個 Print 都會跟著變。

EdgeDetection is the Laplacian: centre +8, the eight neighbours -1. On flat pixels the nine terms cancel to 0; on the lone bright pixel it answers 800, the figure the textbook works out by hand. Either side of the vertical edge it gives +300 and -300.

EdgeDetection 就是 Laplacian：中心 +8、周圍八格各 -1。落在平坦區時九項互相抵消，得到 0；落在那個孤立亮點上會給 800，正是課本手算出來的數字。垂直邊兩側則分別是 +300 和 -300。

The fourth kernel is not a preset: preset is Custom and all nine weights are 1/9, which averages the window. The flat halves keep 100 and 200, the lone pixel smears down to 111.11, and the edge becomes a 133.33 -> 166.67 ramp. Edit the grid to invent a filter.

第四個 kernel 不是內建的：preset 設成 Custom，九個權重全是 1/9，等於把視窗取平均。兩塊平坦區維持 100 與 200，孤立亮點被抹成 111.11，邊界變成 133.33 -> 166.67 的斜坡。改那九格就能自己發明一個濾波器。
